changelog: Valenixia POS v2.8.0 Enterprise Licensing, KYC Merchant Identity Binding, Zero-Loophole Entitlement Enforcement & Universal Packaging Release.
changes: Integrated merchant KYC profile capture (Owner Name, Verified WhatsApp/Phone, Business Email, Operating City, and Tax NTN) with cryptographic HWID device attestation in First-Boot Wizard
Implemented zero-loophole fail-closed licensing: premium features strictly locked on Free tier until admin verifies and approves upgrade claim
Enhanced frictionless self-service payment proof submission in subscription.html with real-time polling to auto-activate upon admin 1-click license minting
Secured Admin Control Plane in admin.html with cryptographic Ed25519 token generation bound to terminal hardware ID
Standardized universal release packages: valenixia-pos.apk (Android) and valenixia-pos.exe (Desktop) in download center and in-app portals
Resolved flexbox centering negative-coordinate clipping across all bootstrapping overlays and modal viewports on mobile devices
Passed all 80 unit tests, 15 database integration tests, 8 mobile scroll tests, 11 bootstrap architecture tests, and 29 runtime acceptance checks
